title: port: include expired-but-unrevoked keys (D9)
description: Critic 2026-10-22: git-vouch-migrate port skips keys expired before C (NOT_LIVE, line ~58), but D9 accepts expired-but-unrevoked keys as continuity proof, so those holders get no draft with migratedFrom. port must emit drafts for expired-but-unrevoked person keys (still skip revoked and non-person keys).
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic keyring test: expired-unrevoked key gets a draft with migratedFrom; revoked key does not; counts against ~/GIT/pgpkeys@af88128 include the 17 expired keys.
notes:
Done (not closed). port now skips only revoked/invalid primaries (SKIPPED); expired drafted with migratedFrom. Group pick: newest unexpired key, else newest. Auth subkeys still only pre-filled if live. Summary gains 'expired N'. pgpkeys@af88128 judged at C (2026-10-20): gpg shows 16 expired, 0 revoked (17 is the count at 2026-10-22); 7 of 16 are kernel.org list keys, so 9 new drafts (605->614); the 605 existing drafts are byte-identical.
QUESTION for owner: DESIGN.md 'Porting pgpkeys' (line ~515) says port drafts each 'live person key', but D9 and line ~528 accept expired keys and port now drafts expired-but-unrevoked keys too. Suggest rewording it to 'each unrevoked person key'. Left DESIGN.md unedited (lane rule). Reviewer follow-up: tests added for the all-expired group fallback (hank) and for an auth subkey under an expired primary (eve).
